dedupe_keys.name: arcom moldova coverage and subscriber map broadband by district and locality mobile coverage and electronic communications market developments

description: The Moldovan communications regulator, renamed ARCOM from ANRCETI, runs an interactive coverage map with a statistics layer. Behind the map, a public JSON interface returns fixed broadband subscribers by district and by locality for the years 2022 to 2025, split by technology (xDSL, FTTx, cable and other), for residential and business users, with shares and district coordinates, together with progress series. The map application also carries mobile network layers for LTE and 5G, including operator layers such as Orange. The regulator's market monitoring pages describe quarterly and annual developments in mobile telephony, mobile internet, fixed telephony, internet access and data transmission, and broadcasting and retransmission, and older quarterly workbooks from 2013 to 2019 are on the national open data portal. Coverage: Moldova, by district and locality. Format and access: web map with a JSON interface, and XLSX workbooks on dataset.gov.md, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the JSON endpoints are undocumented and may change; mobile coverage layers were not queried; the open data workbooks stop in 2019. Simulation uses: district and locality baselines of fixed broadband take-up by technology for Moldovan service and resilience models. Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give national series; the ANCOM Netograf internet quality data cover neighbouring Romania.
